description: "Subdomains of [domain]" / "what hosts exist under [X]" / "find an admin or staging subdomain" — passive DNS host search via HackerTarget, listing known subdomains of a domain with their IPs, drawn from previously observed DNS data rather than by guessing names. Use for attack-surface inventory or to find a forgotten staging host.

target.description: Registrable domain to enumerate, e.g. "pipeworx.io" (not a subdomain).

name: dns_host_search
title: Dns Host Search
